title: abrahamaiproject-bit/fleet-dashboard
body:
# fleet-dashboard

Next.js web dashboard where fleet managers view live vehicle locations, route plans, and on-time delivery KPIs.

## Running locally
```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

## Contact
Questions about the dashboard roadmap go to Joe Smith.
